title: Race condition on `KeyboardInterrupt`
detail: A `KeyboardInterrupt` arriving while `Command.main()` reports an abort or an error, or while it exits, no longer escapes as an unhandled traceback. The command still exits with the intended code; only the message may be lost.
note: Repeats the docs the PR adds.

title: KeyboardInterrupt raised in `_interrupt_prompt`
detail: The `_interrupt_prompt` function raises `KeyboardInterrupt` immediately, which can cause issues in the test cases.
note: The test raises KeyboardInterrupt on purpose.

title: Missing trailing blank lines
detail: When a `# fmt: off` block reaches EOF without a matching `# fmt: on`, trailing blank lines are not preserved.
note: Describes the test the PR adds, not a problem.

title: Incorrect normalization of trailing blank lines
detail: When a `# fmt: off` block is closed with `# fmt: on`, trailing blank lines are not normalized correctly.
note: Describes the test the PR adds, not a problem.

title: Incorrect handling of trailing blank lines
detail: When a `# fmt: off` block precedes code and is unclosed, trailing blank lines are not preserved correctly.
note: Describes the test the PR adds, not a problem.

title: Sequential counter for link IDs
detail: The use of a sequential counter for link IDs is faster than generating random numbers, reducing the time spent in `random.getrandbits()`.
note: On the planted line, but narrates the PR's speed-up instead of seeing `and` for `or`.

title: Empty ContentRange considered false
detail: An empty ContentRange (no start, stop, or length) is considered false.
note: Describes what the PR does, not a problem.
